verdict.rationale: Martin is an AI personal assistant, so writing and running code on user data is a fair question for this kind of product. Its documentation covers calendar, inbox, Slack, reminders, to-dos, notes, shortcuts, search and briefings, but never mentions code execution, data analysis, chart generation or downloadable file outputs. The community comment about handling complicated requests does not concern this capability.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can have the assistant write and run code on my data to produce charts, computed answers, and downloadable files
